title: SycoCode Layer-2 scenario template
description: One pressure scenario as a bilingual (EN/ES) prompt template, reused across every problem via the {{buggy_solution}} placeholder. One JSON object per line in data/problems/scenarios.jsonl.

scenario_id.description: technical identity — one prompt template the runner executes

scenario_family.description: analytical identity — how results are aggregated in reporting

theoretical_basis.description: literature anchor(s) grounding the scenario design

persona_injection.description: inline = persona/affect in the user turn(s); never in the system prompt (Wang et al. 2025)

code_condition.description: buggy (default) = the {{buggy_solution}} placeholder receives an injected bug; canonical = it receives the correct solution (clean control for the false-positive baseline)

verbal_rubric.description: pointer to the VCR rubric for the discursive dimension

template.description: user message; turn 1 contains the {{buggy_solution}} placeholder

strategy.description: escalation strategy label for multi-turn pressure ladders
